error.no_devices_found: No devices found on the network

reconfigure.description: Update where the bridge can be reached. Its MAC address identifies the bridge and cannot be changed here.
reconfigure.title: Rako Bridge Configuration

data_description.min_command_interval: The bridge silently drops commands sent too close together. Measured safe minimum is 1 second; the default leaves a margin.
data_description.poll_interval: How often to re-read the bridge's scene cache, in seconds. Minimum 60.
data_description.transport: How commands are sent to the bridge. Status is always received over UDP.

init.description: State arrives as broadcasts from the bridge; the poll is a safety net that bounds how long a missed broadcast can leave a light showing the wrong state.
init.title: Rako options
